name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not with a racing family, but with a childhood fascination for flight simulators. This passion led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in simulation and modeling. After graduating, she landed a role at a small aerospace firm, but her heart remained set on racing. She transitioned to motorsport, initially working on data analysis before moving into simulator development and engineering.

Klara's approach to simulator engineering is driven by a desire to create the most realistic and effective training environment possible. She believes that the simulator should not only replicate the car's behavior but also the nuances of the track and the pressures felt by the driver. She is known for her meticulous attention to detail, her ability to identify and solve complex technical problems, and her collaborative spirit, working closely with drivers and other engineers to refine the simulator experience. What sets her apart is her talent for translating real-world driver feedback into tangible improvements in the simulation software and hardware. She's always looking to the cutting edge of what is possible.

At EVO Racing Team, Klara is responsible for the continuous improvement of the simulator, ensuring it remains a valuable tool for driver development and race preparation. Her expertise has already contributed to noticeable gains in driver performance, solidifying her reputation as a rising star in the world of simulator engineering.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Klara is of average height with an athletic build, her focused gaze reflecting her sharp intellect.

quirks: Always has a cup of herbal tea on her desk.
Fidgets with a small Rubik's cube when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating the simulator's sound system herself, believing audio feedback is crucial.
